row.scim_plan: Any Advanced module (Roadmaps, Ideas or Feedback)
row.evidence: ProdPad's Entra SSO guide lists availability as "Roadmaps Advanced, Ideas Advanced, Feedback Advanced" and says these accounts "can set up SCIM so that users are auto-provisioned"; the pricing page sells each module at one price (Ideas and Feedback $36, Roadmaps $44 per seat/mo annually).
row.notes: New row. ProdPad is sold per module and per editor seat (Ideas $36, Feedback $36, Roadmaps $44 per seat/mo billed annually; monthly billing costs 20% more); reviewers are free. Help-centre availability boxes put SAML SSO and SCIM on any Advanced module, and the pricing page shows only one version of each module, so SCIM sits on the cheapest paid plan. The plan guide still says each module has 'an essential and advanced version' and two SSO guides keep an older line limiting automatic provisioning to Performance and Enterprise (see conflicts); if an Essential module is still sold, SCIM would be gated above it. Google and Slack SSO on every module are social sign-in. SCIM 2.0 at https://api.prodpad.com/api/v2/scim with the admin's API key as bearer token; works with Entra (gallery app) and OneLogin (generic SCIM Provisioner); not with the Okta OIN app (SAML/SWA). No group provisioning; roles via a ProdPad extension attribute. REST API v1 (API key or OAuth2) lists, gets and creates users; no delete/deactivate endpoint.

scim.plan: Any Advanced module (Roadmaps, Ideas or Feedback)

auth.token_source: Profile settings > API key (https://app.prodpad.com/me/apikeys); the admin's personal ProdPad API key

operations.notes: Help docs do not say whether updates use PUT or PATCH; Entra maps 'active' from IsSoftDeleted, and the IdP 'Delete' action removes the user.

custom.how: ProdPad extension schema (urn:scim:prodpad:2.0:schema in OneLogin/generic templates; urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:prodpad:2.0:User:role in Entra) carrying 'role' (admin/editor/reviewer) and 'accounts' (account IDs for multi-account provisioning, Performance and above)

roles.how: Extension attribute 'role' with value admin, editor or reviewer; in Entra mapped from SingleAppRoleAssignment(appRoleAssignments). Users default to reviewer when no role is passed.

limitations.text: No SCIM for the Okta app; Okta is SAML/JIT only.
Entra SCIM is not available on Legacy Advanced plans or Modular plans without the Governance power-up.
Multi-account provisioning via the 'accounts' attribute needs Performance or above.
SCIM can push accounts past the purchased admin limit (2020 release note).

scim.notes: SCIM token is the admin's personal ProdPad API key. The generic SAML 2.0 and OneLogin guides still carry an older line limiting automatic provisioning to Performance and Enterprise plans (see conflicts).

capabilities.notes: PUT /user/{id} updates third-party IDs only; role is set at creation. No delete or deactivate endpoint in the spec.

endpoints.purpose: List users with roles in the account (filter by email, external_id, service)
Create a user with a role (reviewer if no editor/admin slots)
Get a user and their role

webhooks_user_events.notes: Listed webhook events cover ideas, feedback and comments; no user events are listed.

audit_log_api.notes: Spec has GET /compliance ('Retrieve information for compliance') with no description of contents; not counted as an audit-log API.

rate_limits.text: No rate limit currently; abusive keys or IPs may be blocked.

okta.notes: OIN app (last updated Oct. 4 2018) ticks SAML and SWA only (page markup); ProdPad says SCIM is not available for its Okta app.

entra.notes: Gallery app with SSO and automatic provisioning tutorials; builder not stated, Microsoft authors the tutorial.

onelogin.notes: ProdPad's guide uses OneLogin's generic 'SCIM Provisioner with SAML (Enterprise Schema)' app, not a ProdPad catalogue connector.
